name: Bell Fibe TV (ARRIS VIP7802)
warnings: This box does not carry much ARRIS/CommScope bloat once content apps are left alone: the default list below is 12 packages - telemetry, two stub apps with no logic at all, and five Google TV services most owners would not miss (Play Games, Play Movies & TV, YouTube Music, Android TV's own feedback reporter, and the stock recommendation-row service, which this box's own launcher doesn't even read).
